name: edgital-qa
description: QA task: System Under Test plus Postman/Newman API tests and Serenity/JS E2E tests. This root manifest exists so IDEs recognise the repo as a Node.js/JavaScript project (and resolve Cucumber.js steps) instead of misdetecting it as a Java/Gradle build. It is intentionally NOT an npm workspace: each folder keeps its own package.json / lockfile and is installed independently (the CI does `cd e2e-tests && npm ci`).

scripts.test:api: cd api-tests && npx -y -p newman -p newman-reporter-htmlextra newman run road-overview.postman_collection.json -e road-overview.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Road Overview – API-Tests" --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle "API-Tests" --reporter-htmlextra-omitResponseBodies --reporter-htmlextra-testPaging
